test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Armature and Coil Winder) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following care and maintenance of a marking table is INCORRECT?

options.text: The marking table should be protected from rust.
After use, the marking table should be cleaned with a soft cloth
The marking table should be protected from damage
The surface of the marking table should not be given a thin layer of oil

solution:
The correct answer is __The surface of the marking table should not be given a thin layer of oil****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Marking tables__ are essential tools for precision work in various industries.
 
• Proper care and maintenance ensure their longevity and accuracy.
 
• Rust prevention is critical to avoid damage and deterioration.
 
• Cleaning with a soft cloth after use helps maintain the surface quality.
 
• Protecting the table from physical damage preserves its functionality.
 
• A thin layer of oil on the surface may lead to slipperiness or contamination of workpieces.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Rust Prevention:**
 
 
• Use anti-rust sprays or coatings to protect the table's surface.
 
• Store the table in a dry environment to avoid moisture-related damage.
 
 
 
• **Cleaning:**
 
 
• Use a clean, soft cloth to remove dust or debris after use.
 
• Avoid abrasive materials that might scratch the surface.
 
 
 
• **Protection:**
 
 
• Ensure the table is not exposed to heavy impact or excessive loads.
 
• Use covers or shields to prevent accidental damage.
